# iru_blueprint_templates (Data Source)

Lists built-in Blueprint template identities and category names for selecting a create/clone source. Template IDs are positive integers represented as strings, suitable for iru_blueprint.source_id with source_type=template. Excludes parameter definitions and descriptions. Results are complete, bounded and sorted by numeric template ID.

The catalog response groups templates by category. This lookup flattens only IDs and names, validates every page, and sorts by numeric template ID. It excludes parameter definitions and descriptions. The returned string ID is suitable for iru_blueprint.source_id when source_type is template; template cloning does not make parameter definitions writable.

## Example Usage


```terraform
data "iru_blueprint_templates" "available" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Logical catalog identifier: blueprint_templates.
- `templates` (Attributes List) Template/catalog identity projection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `category_id` (String) Positive integer category ID represented as a string.
- `category_name` (String) Category name.
- `id` (String) Positive integer template ID represented as a string.
- `name` (String) Template name.
